Oneliner

The satellite is an iSIM-SAT 16U-CubeSat, equipped with an iSIM-90 camera onboard.
Description

The satellite is an iSIM-SAT 16U-CubeSat, equipped with an iSIM-90 camera onboard, a binocular telescope developed by SATLANTIS providing four spectral bands and a high resolution below two meters.
Notes

Looks like a NanoAvionics satellite but does not seem to be officially published besides "returning customer" as of May 2023.
